name: Screen Studio
tagline: Create polished demos with screen recordings that automatically zoom in on your actions.
description:
Screen Studio is a Mac screen recorder built for polished product demos, tutorials, and social videos. It records the screen, camera, microphone, and connected mobile devices, then applies visual treatment such as smooth cursor movement, automatic zoom, backgrounds, and framing without requiring a separate video editor for every clip.

The workflow is designed to make ordinary screen capture look intentional. Instead of recording first and spending hours keyframing cursor pans or crops later, you can focus on the demonstration while Screen Studio handles much of the motion and composition automatically.

## Features

- Record Mac screens, windows, microphone audio, camera input, and system audio in a native macOS application optimized for current Mac hardware.
- Record an iPhone or iPad screen wirelessly alongside the Mac screen for mobile-app demonstrations and cross-device tutorials.
- Apply automatic zooms, smooth cursor motion, cursor highlights, and framing that draw attention to the important action.
- Add backgrounds, device frames, text, and other visual treatments to make a recording ready for a presentation or product page.
- Edit the capture in a focused timeline before exporting common video formats and resolutions.
- Use the app’s automatic styling as a starting point, then adjust motion and composition when a particular demonstration needs more control.

## Where it fits

Screen Studio is best for people who need polished software demos quickly and do not want to build every cursor move in a conventional editor. It is particularly effective for tutorials, launch videos, onboarding material, and short product explainers.

It is not a replacement for a full post-production workflow involving complex edits, broadcast tools, or deep audio mixing. Automatic effects also need review so a video’s motion matches the story rather than becoming distracting.

## Privacy and requirements

Screen Studio recommends macOS 13.1 or later and can request Screen Recording, Accessibility, camera, and microphone permissions. Transcription is performed on the Mac according to the developer, while shareable links upload exported material to its service. Usage collection is consent-based, but crash logs and account or license information can still be processed under its privacy policy.

## Pricing

Screen Studio is subscription-based: $29/month or $9/month billed annually.
